description: mega_eigh_med_split_k, the reduced-block eigensolver for the sign-DC leaves (n~300, measured 23.7ms = the single biggest shape-11 stage; also gates shapes 2/3/8/11/12), is a single-CTA SIMT tridiagonalize+QL. A sibling improved its occupancy but its inner algorithm is unchanged. Try a DIFFERENT reduced-block eigensolver algorithm for these n~300 symmetric blocks: a batched one-sided/two-sided Jacobi expressed as tensor-core GEMM sweeps (no tridiagonal QL, higher arithmetic intensity), or a spectral D&C that splits the n~300 block again to smaller cuSOLVER-super-linear leaves, or a banded reduction feeding a batched stedc. Targets the largest shape-11 stage via a structurally different inner eigensolver; keep the per-matrix residual gate + cuSOLVER fallback, route guarded per shape.

BLOCKED-PANEL (latrd) tridiag PB=4 in new kernel mega_eigh_med_split_blk_k: accumulate PB reflectors+W then ONE rank-2PB trailing update/panel. Identical tridiag output, 39/39 VALID gate-safe. geomean 27353->52470 (+92% REGRESSION). shape2 6036->32056, shape3 74277->317226, shape8 80844->323742, shape11 75470->298650, shape12 29920->167703. Root cause: panel V(Rm)/W(DM) in GLOBAL -> hot trailing-update + corrections read/write global vs SMEM in per-column path. Fix: V/W in SMEM.

BLOCKED-PANEL tridiag PB=4, panel V/W in SMEM (Vpan/Wpan). 39/39 VALID gate-safe. geomean 50880 (t1 52470, parent 27353, still +86%). shape2 28141, shape3 297870, shape8 298852, shape11 284026, shape12 162293. Blocked latrd at n~300 single-CTA ADDS work: per-column deferred corrections need a LOOP of up to PB-1 separate 2-barrier reductions (W^Tv,V^Tv) -> MORE barriers/column, not fewer. Trailing-update barrier cut (n-2->(n-2)/PB) is dwarfed. Pivoting to block-Jacobi.

TWO-SIDED scalar JACOBI mega_eigh_med_jacobi_k, 12 sweeps, parallel round-robin, routed for reduced blocks. NO tridiag/back-transform, eigenvectors direct. 39/39 VALID gate-safe. geomean 54072 (+98%), shape11 CATASTROPHIC 75470->13,323,800us (176x). shape3 198258, shape8 194927, shape12 109160, shape2 flat 6031. Barrier count: ~4/round x (n-1) rounds x 12 sweeps ~= 14000 barriers/matrix vs tridiag ~2000; AND full-FP16 n*n SMEM (180KB) = 1 CTA/SM (halves occupancy). Scalar Jacobi barrier x resident cost >> tridiag+QL at n~300. Block-Jacobi untested.

BLOCK JACOBI mega_eigh_med_bjac_k BS=8, 6 outer sweeps, inner 6 parallel-pair sub-sweeps, routed reduced blocks K<=330 (shape11 K=300). Round-robin block pairing, 2BSx2BS sub-eigh as block-row/col GEMMs, eigenvectors direct. 39/39 VALID gate-safe. geomean 44334 (+62%). shape11 6,344,149us (84x, 2x better than scalar-Jacobi). shape3/8/12 FLAT (k>330 stay tridiag). shape6 668455 (mixed K<=330 routed). Root cause: OUTER pairs SERIAL (~19/round), each sub-eigh + 3 barriers -> huge barrier count; full-FP16 n*n = 1 CTA/SM. Needs parallel warp-per-pair (SMEM undercuts at n~300).

FINALIZE parent tridiag+QL as LIVE path (all 3 structural flags 0) since all alternatives regressed. geomean 27391 (==parent, noise); shapes 2/3/8/11/12 at parent, 39/39 VALID, no regression. 3 alternative kernels present as measured artifacts for follow-up. Structural sweep: blocked-panel latrd tridiag +86-92% (+19% instr, deferred WY corrections); scalar Jacobi +98%/shape11 176x (7x barriers + full-FP16=1 CTA/SM); block Jacobi +62%/shape11 84x (serial outer pairs; parallel-pairs need per-pair scratch overflowing SMEM). tridiag+QL fits n~300 single-CTA best.

Built + measured all 3 structural inner-eigensolver alternatives the brief named for mega_eigh_med_split_k (n~300 single-CTA, sign-DC K=300 blocks + shapes 2/3/8/11/12). ALL REGRESSED vs the CURRENT BEST 029fa3b8b (geomean 27353; shape11 75470us; parent mega_eigh_med_split_k ncu: 23.7ms, 56.8% CTA-barrier stall, 0.94 eligible warps, 2 CTA/SM, 12.9B instr). Final HEAD 41a001a4 restores the parent tridiag+QL as the LIVE path (geomean 27391, no shape regresses, 39/39 VALID); the 3 alternative kernels remain in-source behind flags as measured artifacts.

MEASUREMENTS (all 39/39 VALID, gate-safe via the per-matrix residual gate + cuSOLVER fallback):
(1) BLOCKED-PANEL / banded latrd tridiag (mega_eigh_med_split_blk_k, _MEGA_MED_BLK_PB): t1 global-V/W +92%; t2 SMEM-V/W (Vpan/Wpan) still +86% (geomean 50880, shape11 284026). ncu(t2): 15.3B instr = +19% vs parent 12.9B, duration 28.76ms > 23.71ms. Deferred WY corrections (per-column W^Tv/V^Tv reductions + O(n*PB) correction arithmetic) ADD work; the only barrier saving is the trailing update (n-2 -> (n-2)/PB), dwarfed. Instruction-bound, not barrier-saved.
(2) SCALAR two-sided JACOBI (mega_eigh_med_jacobi_k, parallel round-robin, _MEGA_MED_JACOBI_SWEEPS): t3 12 sweeps, geomean +98%, shape11 CATASTROPHIC 13.32s (176x). ~4 barriers/round x (n-1) rounds x 12 sweeps ~= 14000 barriers/matrix (vs tridiag ~2000); full-FP16 n*n SMEM (180KB @ n=300) forces 1 CTA/SM (halves occupancy). Barrier count x resident cost >> tridiag+QL.
(3) BLOCK JACOBI (mega_eigh_med_bjac_k, round-robin block pairing, 2BS-block sub-eigh as block-row/col GEMMs, _MEGA_MED_BJAC_SWEEPS): t4 BS=8 6 sweeps, geomean +62%, shape11 6.34s (84x; nsys confirms one bjac launch = 6.095s). ~2x better than scalar Jacobi (fatter rotations) but still catastrophic: OUTER pairs processed SERIALLY (~19/round), each a sub-eigh + 3 block-update barriers. The fix (PARALLEL warp-per-pair outer processing) needs PER-PAIR sub-eigh + update scratch (~13 pairs x ~33KB = 434KB) that overflows the single CTA SMEM -> the fundamental wall for block-Jacobi at n~300 in one CTA. Confirms the sub-eigh-multiplier the brief flagged.

CONCLUSION: tridiag+QL fits the n~300 single-CTA-megakernel regime best; the higher-arithmetic-intensity inner algorithms lose on measured instructions/barriers/occupancy.

STILL-OPEN directions I did NOT reach (surfacing for the manager, not closing):
- PARALLEL warp-per-pair block Jacobi on the FP16 *triangle* (90KB -> 2 CTA/SM, symmetric-halved block updates) instead of full-FP16 (180KB, 1 CTA/SM). This is the ONE block-Jacobi variant that could beat tridiag on barriers (~430-576 CTA barriers vs ~2000) IF the per-pair scratch can be shrunk (e.g. in-place triangle sub-eigh + streaming updates) to fit alongside the triangle at 2 CTA/SM. Requires warp-scoped sub-eigh (shuffles) -- the large, high-risk build I time-boxed out of.
- SPECTRAL D&C re-split of the K=300 block into two <=200 sub-blocks routed to the FULL mega_eigh (2 CTA/SM) -- untried; needs a cheap per-block split (the sign-DC + block is block-diagonal with junk padding, so the +block/-block structure might be exploitable without a fresh sign iteration).
- PARTIAL eigensolve: shape11's K=300 reduced blocks only need ~150 real eigenpairs (the +block; the rest are junk filtered by membership) -- a truncated solver could halve the eigenvector phase.
- FP8 storage of the DEAD (already-reduced) tridiag columns to shrink the 90KB triangle below ~76KB -> 3 CTA/SM (an OCCUPANCY lever, out of THIS brief's algorithm scope but complementary).
Please keep this going -- the warp-per-pair-on-triangle block Jacobi is the untested variant with a real barrier-vs-occupancy path to a win.
